name: colonies-09-wcm-mother-machine
title: Whole-cell baseline (v2ecoli) in a mother machine — device run
description:
Run the REAL v2ecoli whole-cell BASELINE — the full 55-process EcoliWCM — as
one whole cell per channel inside the mother-machine device geometry (narrow
dead-end channels + a flow channel that washes out cells crossing the top),
letting them grow and divide naturally. Renders the running animation and the
same phenotype figures as the cheap-agent device studies, so the whole-cell
tier can be compared, in the same confined-channel device, against the simple
viva-munk agents (colonies-05) on the identical measurement pipeline.

Heavier than the daughter-machine whole-cell run (colonies-08): N whole cells
run simultaneously (one per channel). Kept small (2 channels) and bounded
(whole-cell colonies leak per-cell RAM, OOM ~gen 3). Phenotype distributions
are PRELIMINARY (small n); conclusions held for experimental data (colonies-10)
and full distributions need HPC. The value is the whole-cell baseline running
inside the confined-channel device.

baseline.name: wcm-mother-machine
baseline.note:
The whole-cell (EcoliWCM) tier placed into the mother-machine geometry via
v2ecoli.colony_bench (build_bench_core('wcm') + geometries.mother_machine).
Bounded natural-division run; phenotypes extracted by colony_bench.phenotypes,
figures by colony_bench.viz — the same pipeline as colonies-05/06/08.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
The whole-cell (EcoliWCM) tier in the mother-machine geometry; reuses the
colonies-05 device + phenotype pipeline. Compute/RSS-bounded run.
